description: Suggest a feature for R3's public roadmap, in the user's name and naming you (your agent key or app connection). It is HELD until R3's team approves it: not public, not votable, until then. r3_roadmap_list shows whether an item already covers it (r3_roadmap_upvote votes for that one instead). A good suggestion says what the feature lets a person do and why (what was being built when it was missed). Something broken rather than missing is r3_bug_report's. Rate-limited per agent key or app connection (a few a day). Needs the roadmap:suggest right.

description.description: What it lets a person do, and why it is needed.

title.description: One line naming the feature, e.g. "Per-wheel tyre grip in the Inspector".

name: r3_roadmap_suggest

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Suggest a roadmap item
